# Rhythm Room L.A.

> Underground speakeasy bar and lounge in the Historic Core of DTLA. Live music, games, cocktails and bar bites. Rated 4.6 from 754 Google reviews.

## About
The Rhythm Room was part of mid-century life in downtown Los Angeles, tucked in the basement of the Hayward Hotel. Its motto was "Just for Fun." We brought it back at its original location, and you still walk down the same marble staircase the original patrons used.
It's simply a great local joint with live music and activities, where friends can congregate, laugh and catch up over light bites and a drink. There's a huge bar up front, and a separate lower area with pool tables, ping pong and shuffleboard.
We keep things simple and basic and focus on quality. Folks seem to agree: we're rated 4.6 from 754 Google reviews.

## Services
- Live music: Live jazz and bands on the stage in the back, with sofas and seating where you can listen or just talk with friends.
- Games: Tabletops inlaid with chess boards, plus board games that range from easy to moderate.
- Ping pong, billiards and shuffleboard: A whole separate lower area set up for games, away from the bar.
- RRLA Signature Old Fashioned: Bourbon, demerara syrup, chocolate, orange and Angustora bitters, Luxardo cherry and orange rind. ($17)
- Bar bites: Nachos, cheeseburgers, tater tots, carnitas tacos, fried birria wontons and po boy sandwiches. Order at the bar and we'll bring it out to you.
- $5 on the daily shots: A variety of spirits that rotates frequently. ($5)
- 2 for $22 special: Changes weekly. Check the board for the cocktails and spirits on special. ($22)
- Event space: Reach out by phone, text or email to ask about the space.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Thursday, Friday and Saturday, 6:00 PM – 2:00 AM. Sunday, 6:00 PM – 12:30 AM. We're closed Monday through Wednesday.

Q: How do I find the entrance?
A: Look for the big wooden door underneath 2 gooseneck lamps, right next to the hotel entrance.

Q: Where can I park?
A: There are over 5 parking lots and structures within a block, plus metered street parking. Uber and Lyft find us easily too.

Q: Is there a cover charge?
A: One reviewer said there's a cover charge at the door of about $5, and that security checks IDs when you arrive.

Q: Who's playing tonight?
A: The lineup changes, so one reviewer suggests calling ahead to find out what live entertainment is on for the night.

## What customers say
- "Great place to enjoy jazz music in a speakeasy kind of location.

Walking down the stairs from the main entrance literally transports you away from the craziness of downtown L.A. into a friendly and welcoming bar. There is something for everyone here. The drinks are great. Beer is fresh and cold on tap in addition to other alcoholic spirts if that is your flavor. The bar also host as a kitchen. Food is simple and taste great. Further down the bar you can be entertained with live music or converse with friends while relaxing at the multiple sofas and other seating areas. There are a few pool tables as well as board games to also pass the time. The layout of the place was great because the chill zones are separated from the bar.

Recommend you call before hand to find out live entertainment for the night. Staff was super friendly and attentive. Super clear establishment." (W O'Brien, 5/5)

- "Really cool underground bar/night club with great live music.  We had no expectations we came by this spot and we had a really good time. The food was good and the music was even better. Here are some thoughts:

Environment
At the time you arrive you are greeted by security who will check your IDs. There is a cover charge to get in. I believe it was $5 and they do take cards if you don't have cash. Once you're in walk down a flight of steps with really cool decor. It seems like there might not be much to the place but then it opens up into the establishment with booths straight ahead, a bar to your right and further into the space is more seating, pool tables, ping pong, and shuffleboard theres are a huge projector that doubles as a stage for live music. The ambiance is real dope, it gives us gringy, speakeasy vibes but busy and lively. We came on a good night where there was great live music. You order everything at the bar - food and drinks. You can grab your drinks and they give you a number and bring your food out to you. Overall pretty easy and even when it was busy it didn't take too long to order and get everything you needed. Overall pretty good experience and really enjoyed the vibes. If you're look for a lighter crowd i suggest getting their early. It looks like it may pretty lively as the night goes on.

Service
didn't really have much service. The security was cool and welcoming - no issues there and the bartenders were pretty quick and efficient even with a huge crowd.

Food and drinks
The food was pretty solid. We had the nachos, the burger and some fries. All were good. My colleague really enjoyed the nachos - I'm not sure if it's because she likes nachos a ton or if it was just that good. lol But overall the food is good enough to go back and solid to have again.

Overall
Really cool spot and good for live music and some solid food and if you want to play some games with friends. Also good for a quick drink before going out to dinner or enjoying the rest of your night. Loved the decor and the ambiance. Would go back." (Michael Richardson, 4/5)
